joined.title: The attrition win may not hold
joined.subtitle: Attrition (Workday) x Slack engagement (Slack) x offer acceptance (Greenhouse) - indexed, Sep = 100

insight.headline: Slack engagement down 24% since May even as attrition hit a 12-month low of 11.4%
insight.detail: Overlaying the three feeds shows the celebrated attrition decline decoupling from its leading indicator: messages per user fell from 49 to 37 in the Jun-Aug window while exits kept improving and offer acceptance climbed to 87.5%. Workday only reports exits that already happened, Greenhouse only sees candidates coming in, and Slack alone can't tell whether quiet channels matter — but engagement historically leads attrition by about two quarters, so the join flags a Q1 FY27 rebound risk no single system surfaces.
insight.action: Pull the Jun-Aug channel-activity cut by team into the 13:00 attrition deep-dive and target stay interviews at the quietest cohorts
